# @nucleux/nav-panel

Expanded navigation panel with collapsible sections — Nucleux agentic UI for React.

Part of **[Nucleux](https://github.com/intelligaia-open-labs/nucleux)** — agentic UI components for React. Install a single component, or the full kit via [`@nucleux/react`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nucleux/react).

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @nucleux/nav-panel @nucleux/tokens
```

`react` / `react-dom` are peer dependencies.

## Usage

```tsx
import { NavPanel, NavPanelHeader, NavSection, NavItem } from "@nucleux/nav-panel";
```

Requires the theme once in your app: `import "@nucleux/tokens/styles.css";`
and the Tailwind preset from `@nucleux/tokens/preset`.

## License

MIT © Nucleux

# @nucleux/utils

cn() class merger + shared types for Nucleux — Nucleux agentic UI for React.

Part of **[Nucleux](https://github.com/intelligaia-open-labs/nucleux)** — agentic UI components for React. Install a single component, or the full kit via [`@nucleux/react`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nucleux/react).

## Install

```bash
pnpm add @nucleux/utils @nucleux/tokens
```

`react` / `react-dom` are peer dependencies.

## Usage

```tsx

```

Requires the theme once in your app: `import "@nucleux/tokens/styles.css";`
and the Tailwind preset from `@nucleux/tokens/preset`.
